card.name: Just before listed body symptoms
card.fires_on: Commas, linking words and verbs like include or an, right before a list of whole-body symptoms such as fever, chills, malaise or withdrawal signs. Seen mostly in opioid withdrawal and reaction descriptions.

modes.label: Withdrawal symptom lead-in
modes.description: Words like an or include just before the signs of an acute withdrawal syndrome.
modes.example: administration of the recommended usual dosage of the antagonist will precipitate<< an>> acute withdrawal syndrome.

modes.label: Comma in symptom list
modes.description: A comma or or inside a list of general symptoms such as fever, chills, malaise.
modes.example: characterized by the occurrence of headache, fever<<,>> chills, sweating, sore throat,

modes.label: Systemic reaction phrase
modes.description: The word of before systemic reaction.
modes.example: tends to increase the incidence<< of>> systemic reaction.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for whole-body or general symptoms (systemic, body, dizziness, heartbeat), including Chinese ones.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to list general body symptoms like fever, chills or withdrawal signs.
